origin: Oregon Team's story is one etched in the heart of the Emilia-Romagna region, born from a shared love of motorsport amongst a group of friends in Modena. It wasn't about deep pockets or corporate backing; it was about passion and a relentless DIY spirit. In 2008, Marco Bellini, a local mechanic with dreams of racing, rallied his friends – mostly fellow mechanics, engineers, and racing enthusiasts from the local university – to pool their resources. They scraped together enough to purchase a secondhand Formula Ford chassis and converted a dusty workshop on the outskirts of town into their makeshift headquarters. Their early seasons were a trial by fire, full of mechanical failures and near misses, but their unwavering camaraderie and infectious enthusiasm quickly earned them a loyal following among local racing fans.
philosophy: Oregon Team operates on the principle of incremental improvement and unwavering dedication. They believe in maximizing performance through meticulous preparation, clever engineering solutions, and a driver-centric approach. Car development is a collaborative process, with input from every team member valued equally. Their team culture emphasizes mutual respect, open communication, and a shared commitment to pushing the limits of their resources and talent.
achievements: 2012: Secured a podium finish at the Mugello Circuit in the Italian Formula Ford Championship.
2015: Won the Emilia-Romagna Regional Touring Car Championship.
2018: Successfully completed the arduous Targa Florio rally, finishing mid-pack against much better-funded teams.
2021: Discovered and nurtured rising star Alessandro Rossi, who later moved to a higher-tier racing series.

teamPrincipal.name: Marco Bellini
teamPrincipal.background: Marco is a self-taught engineer and experienced mechanic. He leads with a hands-on approach, fostering a family-like atmosphere within the team and inspiring them with his unwavering belief in their potential.

keyFigures.name: Sofia Russo
keyFigures.description: Sofia is a brilliant tactician who uses her sharp analytical skills to devise innovative race strategies, often outsmarting teams with significantly larger budgets.

keyFigures.name: Giovanni Esposito
keyFigures.description: Giovanni is a master craftsman known for his resourcefulness and ability to coax exceptional performance from aging machinery.

headquarters: Oregon Team is based in a converted workshop on the outskirts of Modena, Italy. Their facilities are basic but functional, featuring a small garage, a rudimentary fabrication area, and a cramped office space where race strategies are planned.
fanBase: Oregon Team enjoys a fiercely loyal following among local racing enthusiasts, who appreciate their down-to-earth approach, unwavering passion, and occasional giant-killing performances. They are seen as a true representation of the spirit of Italian motorsport.
